title: Folder tidy-up script
desc: Sort a messy Downloads folder into subfolders by file type and date. Add a dry-run flag that only prints what it would move.

title: Personal expense tracker
desc: Import bank CSV exports into a SQLite file and print monthly totals by category from the command line.

title: Weather on the command line
desc: Fetch a forecast from the free Open-Meteo API and print a tidy 3-day summary for your town.

title: Markdown to static site
desc: Turn a folder of Markdown notes into linked HTML pages with an index. This site is built the same way.

title: Web page change watcher
desc: Check a page on a schedule, store a hash, and show a diff when it changes. Be polite: fetch rarely and respect robots.txt.

title: Password generator
desc: Generate strong random passwords or word-based passphrases, with flags for length and symbols.

title: Quiz from a JSON file
desc: Ask questions from a file in random order and keep score. Write a question set on one of your hobbies.

title: Word counts for a classic book
desc: Download a plain-text book from Project Gutenberg and list its most common words. Compare two authors.

title: Pomodoro timer
desc: A command-line timer for 25-minute work blocks and short breaks that logs each finished block to a file.

title: Game of Life in the terminal
desc: Animate Conway's Game of Life with plain characters. Add a few famous starting patterns.

title: Photo renamer
desc: Rename photos by the date stored inside them so that a folder sorts in the order the pictures were taken.

title: Feed reader
desc: Read a list of RSS feeds and print the newest headlines. The collector behind this site does the same.

title: Text adventure engine
desc: Describe rooms, items and exits in a data file, and write a small engine that lets you walk around.

title: Maze generator and solver
desc: Carve a random maze, print it, then find the way out with a breadth-first search.

title: Spirograph with turtle
desc: Draw looping spirograph curves and experiment with the numbers until something beautiful appears.

title: Sudoku solver
desc: Solve any sudoku by backtracking, then time it on puzzles rated as the hardest.

title: Link shortener
desc: A tiny web server on your own machine that turns long links into short codes and redirects them.

title: Mandelbrot picture
desc: Compute the Mandelbrot set pixel by pixel and save it as an image. Then try your own colour scheme.

title: Nonsense text generator
desc: Build a Markov chain from a book and generate new sentences in the same style.

title: Duplicate file finder
desc: Find identical files by hashing their contents and report how much space the copies waste.
